from scipy.optimize import least_squares
e=eps.values;t=T.values;y=s.values
def model(p):
    return p[0]+p[1]*np.sqrt(e)+p[2]*np.exp(-p[3]*t)*e**p[4]
best=None
for k in range(30):
    p0=np.random.randn(5)
    try:
        r=least_squares(lambda p: model(p)-y, p0)
        if best is None or r.cost<best.cost: best=r
    except Exception: pass
res=y-model(best.x)
print(best.x, np.mean(res**2)/np.var(y))
print(np.round(np.corrcoef(res,t)[0,1],3))
order=np.argsort(t)
for i in order[::15]: print(round(t[i],3), round(e[i],3), round(res[i],3))
